top_signals.title: US cybersecurity startup bets $200m on London expansion
top_signals.summary: A US cybersecurity startup valued at $3.5bn is opening a new London hub as part of a $200m expansion across Europe, the Middle East and Africa, creating 200 jobs as demand for cyber defences surges. top_signals.title: French Bond-Risk Gauge Breaches Key Level After Protests
top_signals.summary: A measure of French bond risk breached a key level on Tuesday, underscoring the challenges facing the government as it struggles to tame the budget deficit and grapples with cost-of-living protests.
